overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Zoom access failure occurred after the Board had adjourned. It also reminded the Board to review and respond to complaints within 14 business days.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a member of the public (Dr. Gandhi, invited to speak on a petition) could not access the January 13 board meeting via Zoom.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the undisputed evidence provided to our office, we find that at the time Dr. Gandhi tried to access the Board's January 13 meeting the meeting had been adjourned.

allegations.summary: Not alleged by complainant. AG observed the Board may not have met to review the complaint before the Health Director responded, and reminded it of the 14-business-day rule.
allegations.key_passage: A public body may delegate authority to respond to a complaint to legal counsel or other individual, but the public body must first meet to review the complaint.
